summary: Checked all 16 estimates: 12 descriptive contrasts from Table 2 and four GenAI regression rows from Table 3. Read the complete markdown conversion, including Appendix A and references, and extracted the relevant PDF pages. All recorded means, SDs, coefficients, SEs, p-value bounds, and non-null analysis counts match the correct PDF rows. Outcome coding, timing, AI availability, comparison types, direction, and uncertainty coding agree with the paper and codebook. The individual-arm regression mapping is supported by the Results interpretation and parallel Table 3 predictor structure. Unspecified team headcounts, observation units, SD levels, regression counts, and coefficient scaling are appropriately left unresolved. Self-reports, post-treatment strategy analyses, mediation, and factorial interaction coefficients are appropriately excluded; the unidentified Table 6 team coefficient cannot establish another eligible arm contrast. No additional identifiable in-scope outcome or reported contrast was found.
